root: General open-web research now routes through `retrieval search`, with an optional SerpBase provider for users who set `SERPBASE_API_KEY`.
One availability contract keeps configured-only commands aligned across CLI help, search, describe, completion, schemas, Agents, retrieval, and MCP.
SerpBase follows the current `POST /google/search` contract, preserves typed JSON input, and reports authentication, quota, and HTTP failures through structured envelopes.
Paid providers stay explicit, so default and all-provider research never spends SerpBase credits.
zh: 通用开放网页研究现由 `retrieval search` 承接。设置 `SERPBASE_API_KEY` 后可显式选用 SerpBase。
统一的 availability 契约让 CLI help、search、describe、completion、schema、Agent、retrieval 和 MCP 对配置型命令保持一致。
SerpBase 按当前 `POST /google/search` 契约发送请求，保留 JSON 参数类型，并通过结构化 envelope 报告鉴权、额度和 HTTP 错误。
付费 provider 只接受显式选择，默认检索与 `all` 均不会消耗 SerpBase 额度。
